figures.title: Grid Representation of Sample Space
figures.description: A 4×4 grid illustrating the sample space of two rolls of a tetrahedral die. The horizontal axis is labeled below as 'X = First roll' with markings 1, 2, 3, and 4 corresponding to each column. The vertical axis is labeled to the left as 'Y = Second roll' with markings 1, 2, 3, and 4 from bottom to top corresponding to each row, forming 16 distinct cells representing the possible pairs of outcomes.

figures.title: Tree Diagram (Sequential Description) of Sample Space
figures.description: A probability tree diagram illustrating the sequential outcomes of two rolls. The root on the left branches into four first-stage nodes labeled 1, 2, 3, and 4 from top to bottom, representing the first roll. From node 1, four branches lead to outcomes explicitly labeled '1,1', '1,2', '1,3', and '1,4'. Nodes 2 and 3 each branch into four lines without endpoint labels. Node 4 branches into four lines, with the lowest branch labeled '4,4'.
